notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.notes: [p]Hello, everyone! We have been releasing hotfixes to fix bugs all these days. [/p][p]Thank you all for your feedback! Thanks to it, we were able to fix many minor [/p][p]bugs and crashes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/94536665cf5229a4d4fb0cef3d4e8f22aa4dd291.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Here is a list of fixes: [/p][p]1) Fixed a crash bug in the second episode when arriving at the college.[/p][p]2) Removed unnecessary interface menus.[/p][p]3) Fixed bugs in the Artbook.[/p][p]4) Fixed bugs in the Russian localization that caused the game to crash.[/p][p]5) In the Chinese localization, issues with entering passwords in the game have been resolved.[/p][p]6) The way cheats work has been changed.[/p][p]7) Fixed bugs that arose due to the redesign of the cheat mechanism.[/p][p]8) Improved several images in the prologue and the first episode[/p][p]9) Prepared for the addition of Achievements in Steam[/p][p]10) Simplified the principle of finding money in College in the first free roam[/p][p]11) Fixed points and missing phrases in localizations[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/482d5470f08c47fd2a6559cc7187d087c85f51e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We will continue working to fix the game's flaws![/p][p]Thank you again for your help in finding errors and bugs.[/p]

notes.title: My Ex-Future Family Season 2 Episode 3. Release has come!
notes.notes:
Well, it's time to talk about the features of the new episode:

[list]
[*] 300+ artwork, of course in full HD quality :)
[*] 25 new sex animations, hot and exciting ;)
[*] from 40 to 70 minutes of gameplay (and, if you go through all the branches, a little more)
[*] new hidden pictures and achievements
[*] prepared an interesting update with cats, in general super-cool additional content
[*] 3+ new sex scenes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756570/e7d9117edd947f46df62f767ca01f95040f08c29.jpg[/img]

And this is what's ready from the prologue to the end of episode three:
[list]
[*] almost 2000 full HD artwork! 
[*] 160+ beautiful animations 
[*] over 5 hours of gameplay
[*] many hidden pictures and more than 30 Achievements
[*] replayability :)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756570/a85218a9990801820a99f562ede137c63ca38062.jpg[/img]

This week we'll finish posting additional content to Season 1 page of our game. You're going to love it :)

We will try to release announcements in Steam every week, so you can follow the progress of our work and can appreciate some art from the future game.

Thank you for being with us and see you soon! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756570/cc06a528871ac779a2b3571dcc04b89b0f66fe68.jpg[/img]

And don't forget to add to your Wishlist and hit the follow button to keep up with the latest news!
